blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate technical explainable AI (XAI) artefacts such as SHAP into explanatory narratives (XAINs) for lay users. In high-risk domains, these explanations are often the main resource through which individuals can understand and contest adverse decisions. Yet LLMs are known to reproduce social bias, even from proxy variables alone, and fairness in XAINs remains unstudied. Because XAINs are bound to a ground-truth artefact, fairness concerns not only what a narrative says and how, but also whether it is equally faithful across social groups. We introduce fairness in XAINs as a new field of research and propose a framework that generates narratives under three conditions (protected attribute disclosed, withheld, or counterfactually swapped), allowing five comparisons that pinpoint the cause of disparities. We apply it to adversely classified instances from four datasets in credit scoring, education and employment, generating narratives with five LLMs, and evaluate faithfulness, feature coverage and sentiment. We find significant disparities across all datasets, metric families and models, arising in two ways. Faithfulness disparities result from feature values: LLMs make plausible but false statements, triggered by values that are unequally distributed across social groups. Feature coverage and sentiment disparities stem from the protected attribute itself: once it is disclosed, LLMs give less explanation to, or frame more negatively the narratives of, groups that have historically been discriminated against or are stereotypically associated with worse outcomes. A more faithful model removes the faithfulness disparities, and withholding protected attributes mostly removes the others, but neither suffices on its own. Fairness in XAINs should therefore be audited separately from the predictive model and its XAI artefact.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)被越来越多地用于将SHAP等技术可解释的AI(XAI)手工艺品翻译为非专业用户的解释性叙事(XAINs). 在高风险领域,这些解释往往是个人了解和质疑不利决定的主要资源。 然而,LLMS已知会复制社会偏见,甚至仅从代理变量中产生,而XAINs中的公平性仍未被研究. 因为XAINs与地心真言相接,公平不仅涉及叙述的内容和方式,还涉及它是否同样忠实于各社会群体。 我们引入了XAINs中的公平性,作为一个新的研究领域,并提出了一个框架,在三个条件下产生叙述(受保护的属性被披露,被扣留,或被反向交换),允许进行五个比较,找出差异的原因. 我们将其应用于信贷评分、教育和就业方面的四个数据集中的不利分类情况,生成有五个有限责任公司的说明,并评价忠诚程度、特征覆盖面和情绪。 我们发现,所有数据集、计量家庭和模型存在重大差异,有两种方式。 信仰差异源于特征价值: LLMS作出可信而虚假的言论,这些言论是由不同社会群体不平等分配的价值观所引发的。 特征覆盖和情绪差异源于受保护的属性本身:一旦披露,法学硕士对历来受到歧视或与更恶劣的结果有定型关系的群体的描述作出较少的解释或描述更为负面。 一个更忠实的模型消除了忠诚的悬殊,而扣取被保护的属性大多去除其他的属性,但两者都不足以单独解决. 因此,XAINs中的公平性应与预测模型及其XAI活性分开审计。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: As machine learning (ML) systems are increasingly used in high-risk domains, credit scoring, education assessment and employment screening stand out as cases where explainability is both legally required and socially important ( Lo Piano, 2020 ; Fabeyo, 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Jang et al., 2022 ; Kalasampath et al., 2025 ) . Because these models generally lack interpretability, the field of explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) aims to improve transparency by explaining why the AI system made a decision, allowing model developers and end-users to understand specific decisions and improve model trust ( Molnar, 2025 ; Saarela and Podgorelec, 2024 ; Adadi and Berrada, 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 由于机器学习(ML)系统越来越多地被用于高风险领域,因此信用评分、教育评估和就业筛选在在法律上既需要解释,又具有社会重要性的案例中尤为突出(Lo Piano,2020;Fabieo,2025;Wang等,2025;Jang等,2022;Kalasampath等,2025)。 由于这些模型一般缺乏可解释性,可解释人工智能领域(XAI)旨在通过解释AI系统为何作出决定来提高透明度,使模型开发者和最终用户能够理解具体决定并改进模型信任(Molnar,2025;Saarela and Podgorelec,2024;Adadi and Berrada,2018.).

blocks.en:
This demand for transparency is not only socially important, but also increasingly of legal relevance: The EU AI Act classifies credit scoring, education and employment as high-risk applications under Annex III, meaning that under Article 86, any affected person subject to a decision taken on the basis of the output from such a high-risk system has the right to obtain a “clear and meaningful explanation of the role of the AI system in the decision-making procedure and the main elements of the decision taken” ( European Parliament and Council of the European Union, 2024 ) .
Among the XAI methods developed to meet the explainability demand, SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) ( Lundberg and Lee, 2017 ) has become the dominant approach ( Saarela and Podgorelec, 2024 ; Kalasampath et al., 2025 ) . The SHAP algorithm quantifies how much each feature contributes to a model’s prediction for a specific instance across all possible feature combinations and is widely regarded as the standard for post-hoc, instance-level explanations for tabular data. Despite its popularity, a problem remains: SHAP explanations are often too technical for applicants to understand or use ( Rong et al., 2024 ; Martens et al., 2025 ; Kalasampath et al., 2025 ) , resulting in an interpretability gap between what XAI methods produce and what decision subjects can actually use.
blocks.zh:
这种对透明度的要求不仅对社会很重要,而且越来越具有法律意义: 欧盟AI法将信用评分、教育和就业归类为附件三所述的高风险申请,这意味着根据第86条,任何根据这种高风险体系的产出作出决定的受影响者都有权获得“明确和有意义地解释AI体系在决策程序中的作用和所作决定的主要内容”(欧洲议会和欧洲联盟理事会,2024年)。
在为满足可解释性需求而开发的XAI方法中,SHAP(SHapley Additive ex Planations)(Lundberg and Lee, 2017.)已成为主导方法(Saarela and Podgorelec, 2024;Kalasampath等, 2025.). SHAP算法将每个特征对模型对一个具体实例的预测的贡献量化到所有可能的特征组合中,并被广泛视为表格式数据在hoc后实例一级解释的标准. 尽管它很受欢迎,但仍然存在一个问题:SHAP的解释往往过于技术性,使申请人无法理解或使用(Rong等人,2024年;Martens等人,2025年;Kalasampath等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
This has motivated the move toward eXplainable AI Narratives (XAIN), which use large
language models (LLMs) to translate technical XAI artefacts into natural language explanatory narratives ( Martens et al., 2025 ; Silvestri et al., 2025 ) . The use of LLMs to translate XAI artefacts into narratives allows for structured, story-like explanations that establish cause-effect mechanisms between features ( Cedro and Martens, 2026 ; Martens et al., 2025 ) , improve comprehensibility, and are preferred by lay users over the raw artefacts they are derived from ( Martens et al., 2025 ; Silvestri et al., 2025 ) . An example of this translation step is given in Figure 1 , of which the full narrative can be found in Appendix C in Figure 5 .
blocks.zh:
这促使人们转向解释性AI 说明(XAIN),它们使用大型
语言模型(LLM),将技术XAI工艺品翻译为自然语言解释性叙事(Martens等,2025;Silvestri等,2025.). 使用LLMS将XAI工艺品翻译为叙事,可以进行有条理、类似故事的解释,在特征之间建立因果关系机制(Cedro和Martens, 2026;Martens等人, 2025),提高可理解性,并被非专业用户取而代之地取而代之(Martens等人,2025;Silvestri等人,2025)。 图1举例说明了这一翻译步骤,图5的附录C载有该步骤的全文。

blocks.en: Figure 1. From SHAP to XAIN: the top-3 SHAP features of a German Credit applicant (instance 18) and (part of) the narrative generated by claude-sonnet-4-6 . Colours link each feature to its description in the narrative.
blocks.zh: 图 1. 从SHAP到XAIN:一个德国信用申请者的顶级-3 SHAP特征(Intance 18)和由Claude-sonnet-4-6所生成的叙述(部分). 色彩将每个特征与叙事中的描述联系起来.

blocks.en:
Yet the introduction of LLMs into the explanation pipeline introduces a new and unstudied risk. Coherent narrative generation requires access to the underlying feature values rather than SHAP scores alone ( Ichmoukhamedov et al., 2024 ; Martens et al., 2025 ) , meaning at least parts of the applicant profile must be passed to
the LLM. In contexts qualified as high-risk, sensitive (protected) attributes are legally excluded from predictive model inputs and thus SHAP values will not be computed for them. But even if protected attributes (PAs) are not directly included in the generator prompt, proxies for these attributes are frequently present in the data and passed to the LLM as part of the applicant profile.
blocks.zh:
然而,在解释性项目中引入有限责任公司带来了新的、未经研究的风险。 一致的叙事生成需要访问基本特征值,而不是光是SHAP分数(Ichmoukhamedov等,2024;Martens等,2025),这意味着申请人简介中至少有一部分必须传给
LLM(英语:LLM). 在被定性为高风险的情况下,敏感(被保护)属性在法律上被排除在预测模型输入之外,因此不会为其计算SHAP值. 但是,即使受保护的属性(PAs)没有被直接包含在生成器快取中,这些属性的代名词也经常出现在数据中,并作为申请人配置图的一部分被传递到LLM上.

blocks.en: As research consistently shows that state-of-the-art LLMs produce biased output even based on proxy variables alone ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Gallegos et al., 2024 ; Leidinger and Rogers, 2024 ) , there is no empirical or theoretical basis to expect LLM-generated narratives to be free from social biases. This motivates the research at hand. In high-risk settings where explanations are the main resource through which individuals can understand and improve adverse outcomes, disparities between the narratives of social groups risk allocational and representational harm ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , institutionalizing discrimination under the guise of transparency.
blocks.zh: 正如研究一致表明,先进的LLMS即使仅根据代用变量也会产生偏颇的产出(Bai等人,2025年;Gallegos等人,2024年;Leidinger和Rogers,2024年),没有经验或理论依据可以预期LLM生成的叙述能够摆脱社会偏见. 这推动了手头的研究。 在解释是个人了解和改善不利结果的主要资源的高风险环境中,社会群体的叙述存在分配和代表性损害的风险(Gao等人,2026年),在透明度的幌子下将歧视制度化。

blocks.en: Despite these risks, fairness in XAINs remains unstudied. Fairness has been examined at every step of the pipeline (collecting data, making the prediction and explaining it), but not in the translation of the XAI artefact into a narrative (Fig. 1 ): to the best of our knowledge, no study compares metrics computed on XAINs between social groups, nor do existing literature reviews on XAINs mention fairness concerns ( Mill et al., 2024 ; Silvestri et al., 2025 ; Bilal et al., 2025 ) . We therefore set aside fairness concerns in the earlier steps and focus exclusively on this translation step.
blocks.zh: 尽管存在这些风险,XAINs的公平性仍然没有得到研究. 在管道的每一个步骤(收集数据、作出预测和解释)都审查了公平性,但在将XAI动画翻译成叙事(图1)时没有审查:就我们所知,没有任何研究在社会群体之间比较XAINs计算出的衡量标准,关于XAINs的现有文献评论也没有提到公平问题(Mill等,2024;Silvestri等,2025;Bilal等,2025)。 因此,我们在早先的步骤中不考虑公平问题,而只注重这一翻译步骤。

blocks.en: This paper addresses this gap with four contributions. First, we position fairness in XAINs as a distinct field of research at the intersection of fairness in XAI and fairness in natural language processing (NLP) (Section 2 ). Second, we propose a methodology for auditing fairness in XAINs that generates narratives under three conditions, in which protected attributes are factually disclosed, withheld, or replaced with counterfactual values, and evaluates them on faithfulness, feature coverage and sentiment. Comparing narratives across and within these conditions isolates total, indirect, disclosure, direct and value disparity (Section 3 ). Third, we present the first empirical evaluation of between-group differences in XAINs, generating narratives with five LLMs from three providers, ranging from small to frontier models, for adversely classified instances from four datasets covering the high-risk fields of credit scoring, employment and education. Fourth, we explain where each disparity comes from: the decomposition traces it to its source in the input (the applicant’s feature values, the disclosure of the protected attributes, or their value), and inspecting the narratives behind it reveals the LLM behaviour that produces it (Section 4 ). 1 1 1 Code, prompts, narratives and extractions are available at https://github.com/WannesVandenBulck/fairxain . Section 5 discusses the implications of these findings, and Section 6 concludes.
blocks.zh: 本文件通过提供四份材料来弥补这一差距。 首先,我们把XAINs中的公平作为一个独特的研究领域,处于XAI中的公平与自然语言处理中的公平(NLP)的交叉点(第2节)。 第二,我们提出在XAINs中审计公平性的方法,在三个条件下产生叙述,其中受保护的属性被事实披露,被扣取,或被反事实值所取而代之,并根据忠诚,特征覆盖和情感来评价. 对这些条件之间和内部的叙述进行比较,将完全、间接、披露、直接和价值差异隔离开来(第3节)。 第三,我们介绍了对XAINs中群体间差异的第一次实证评估,通过三个提供者的五个有限责任公司,从小型模式到前沿模式,对涉及信用评分、就业和教育等高风险领域的四个数据集的不利分类案例进行了叙述。 第四,我们解释每一种差异的出处:分解在输入(申请人的特征值、受保护属性的披露或其价值)中追溯到其来源,并检查其背后的叙述揭示了产生这种差异的LLM行为(第4节)。 1 1 1 1 代码、提示、叙述和取出可在https://github.com/WannesVandenBulc克/fairxain网站上查阅。 第5节讨论了这些调查结果的影响,第6节结束。

blocks.en: 2. Background
blocks.zh: 2. 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1. Explainable AI and the Interpretability Gap
blocks.zh: 2.1. 可解释的大赦国际和可解释性差距

blocks.en: The XAI literature is dominated by post-hoc methods in tabular data that explain individual model predictions ( Silvestri et al., 2025 ; Kalasampath et al., 2025 ) . The field grew from the need to explain black-box ML models, after their increasing effect on human lives. Among these, feature attribution artefacts like SHAP ( Lundberg and Lee, 2017 ) and LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations) ( Ribeiro et al., 2016 ) are the most popular, of which SHAP has become the most widely adopted approach ( Saarela and Podgorelec, 2024 ; Kalasampath et al., 2025 ) . However, like most post-hoc explanation methods, research shows that such explanations are too technical for lay people to interpret ( Rong et al., 2024 ) , a failure Miller et al. (2017) describe as “inmates running the asylum,” in which XAI methods are designed by and for data scientists instead of for the individuals whose lives the underlying decisions affect ( Bhatt et al., 2020 ) . This results in an interpretability gap that sits in direct contrast with the purpose of the field: if XAI was introduced to make AI decisions understandable to those affected by them, then methods that remain uninterpretable result in perverse outcomes.
blocks.zh: XAI文献以表格数据中的后热法为主来解释单个模型预测(Silvestri等,2025;Kalasampath等,2025.). 球场发展的原因是,在黑盒ML模型对人的生活产生越来越大的影响后,需要解释. 其中,SHAP(Lundberg and Lee, 2017)和LIME(当地可解释的模型-不可知解释)(Ribeiro等,2016年)等特征归属手工艺品最受欢迎,SHAP已经成为最广泛采用的方法(Saarela and Podgorelec, 2024;Kalasampath等,2025年). 然而,与大多数事后解释方法一样,研究表明,这种解释过于技术性,非专业人员无法解释(Rong等人,2024年),一个失败的米勒等人(2017年)描述为“管理庇护的囚犯”,其中XAI方法由数据科学家设计,并为数据科学家设计,而不是针对那些其基本决定影响其生活的个人(Bhatt等人,2020年)。 这造成了可解释性差距,与领域的宗旨直接相去甚远:如果采用 " AI " ,使受此影响的人可以理解AI的决定,那么仍然无法解释的方法就会导致反常的结果。

blocks.en: In the high-risk domains studied in this paper, all those affected are by definition lay users: loan and job applicants, and students. They cannot be expected to interpret what a SHAP value such as + 0.135 +0.135 means and how the features compare (Fig. 1 ). This results in the inability of adversely classified individuals to understand and contest the decision.
blocks.zh: 在本文研究的高风险领域,根据定义,所有受影响者都是非专业用户:贷款和求职者以及学生。 不能期望它们解释诸如+0.135+0.135等SHAP值意味着什么,以及特征如何比较(图1)。 这导致被负面分类的个人无法理解并质疑这一决定.

blocks.en: 2.2. Explainable AI Narratives
blocks.zh: 2.2. 可解释的大赦国际说明

blocks.en: XAINs address the interpretability gap by translating technical XAI artefacts into natural language explanations through LLMs ( Martens et al., 2025 ) . An XAIN presents a structured, story-like explanation, including cause-effect relationships between input features and the model’s decision ( Cedro and Martens, 2026 ) . This is an advancement from earlier approaches, which were restricted to restating attribution scores or feature-value pairs in prose form, without organizing them into a coherent, context-sensitive narrative ( Cambria et al., 2023 ) , distinguishing XAI narratives from XAI descriptions ( Cedro and Martens, 2026 ) . Martens et al. (2025) introduced SHAPstories as a narrative counterpart to SHAP explanations, showing substantial improvements in comprehensibility and preference by both lay users and domain experts.
blocks.zh: XAINs通过LLMs(Martens等人,2025年)将技术的XAI工艺品翻译成自然语言解释来弥补可解释性的差距。 一个XAIN(XAIN)给出了条理分明,故事式的解释,包括输入特性与模型决定之间的因果关系(Cedro and Martens, 2026.). 这与先前的方法相比是一个进步,这些方法仅限于以改道形式重述归属分数或特征值对等,而没有将它们组织成连贯的,对背景敏感的叙事(Cambria等,2023年),区分了XAI的叙事和XAI的叙事(Cedro和Martens,2026年). Martens等人(2025年)介绍了SHAPstorys,作为SHAP解释的叙事对应,显示出非专业用户和领域专家在理解性和偏好方面的重大改进.

blocks.en: XAINs are generated through a unified ( Martens et al., 2025 ; Ichmoukhamedov et al., 2024 ) pipeline (Figure 6 ), which goes as follows. The process begins with a trained ML model producing a prediction together with the corresponding decision. SHAP values are then computed on top of this prediction and ranked by absolute importance to obtain the top contributing features. This is combined with several additional components (laid out in Section 3.2 ) into a structured prompt (Fig. 7 ), which is passed to an LLM to generate the XAIN.
blocks.zh: XAIN通过一个统一的(Martens等,2025;Ichmoukhamedov等,2024)管道(图6)生成,具体如下. 这一过程从一个经过培训的ML模型开始,该模型在作出预测的同时作出相应的决定。 然后在这个预测的基础上计算SHAP值,并按绝对重要性排序,以获得最高贡献特征. 这与几个额外的组件(分出于第3.2节)合并为一个结构化的快取(图7),然后传递给LLM生成XAIN.

blocks.en: 2.3. Fairness in XAI and NLP
blocks.zh: 2.3. XAI和NLP的公平性

blocks.en: Fairness has been studied separately within the fields of XAI and NLP. Explanation fairness in the context of XAI studies whether the explanations produced by post-hoc XAI artefacts such as SHAP are consistent or of comparable quality across social groups ( Zhao et al., 2023 ; Dai et al., 2022 ; Balagopalan et al., 2022 ) , auditing the fidelity, stability, consistency and sparsity. The field of fairness in XAI seeks to provide explanations of equal quality to different social groups, but until now has left open whether these artefacts are translated fairly into natural-language narratives.
blocks.zh: 在XAI和NLP领域分别研究了公平性. 在XAI的范围内解释公平性,研究HAAP等后XAI工艺品的解释是一致的还是各社会群体的质量相当的(Zhao等人,2023年;Dai等人,2022年;Balagopalan等人,2022年),审计忠诚性、稳定性、一致性和痉挛性。 AI的公平领域力求向不同的社会群体提供同等质量的解释,但迄今为止,这些手工艺品是否被公平翻译成自然语言的叙事一直没有定论。

blocks.en: Meanwhile, the NLP literature has documented how LLMs encode and reproduce social bias. Foundational works have shown that LLMs absorb and amplify stereotypical associations present in their training corpora ( Bolukbasi et al., 2016 ; Caliskan et al., 2017 ) , and more recent works confirm that LLMs continue to exhibit biases across a wide range of generation tasks ( Gallegos et al., 2024 ) . This bias persists even when protected attributes are not present in the input, as LLMs rely on proxy variables correlated with them ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Leidinger and Rogers, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 与此同时,NLP文献记录了LLMs如何编码并再现社会偏见. 基础著作表明,LLMs吸收并扩展了其培训公司中的陈规定型社团(Bolukbasi等,2016年;Caliskan等,2017年),以及更近期的著作证实,LLMs继续在广泛的世代任务中表现出偏见(Gallegos等,2024年)。 即使输入中没有受保护的属性,这种偏差仍然存在,因为LLMs依赖与之相关的代理变量(Bai等,2025;Leidinger和Rogers,2024.).

blocks.en: The consequences of such disparities are of allocational harm, referring to the unequal distribution of resources or opportunities (e.g., access to information on how to escape the adverse class), and representational harm, referring to the reinforcement of stereotypes or the framing of certain groups in persistently more negative terms ( Gao et al., 2026 ) . Both are also relevant to XAINs, since a narrative can misrepresent an individual’s situation and affect their ability to act on or contest an adverse decision.
blocks.zh: 这种差异的后果是分配损害,是指资源或机会分配不均(例如,获得如何逃离不利阶层的信息),以及代表性损害,是指陈规定型的强化或以更消极的用语对某些群体进行陷害(Gao等人,2026年)。 两者都与XAINs有关,因为叙述会歪曲个人的情况并影响他们就不利决定采取行动或提出异议的能力。

blocks.en: Despite this, neither the XAI fairness literature nor the NLP fairness literature directly addresses the setting most relevant to XAINs: fairness in instance-specific, natural-language explanations generated for adversely predicted individuals. Current works in fairness in XAI evaluate the technical artefact but not the XAIN that translates it, while works in fairness in NLP typically study bias in open-ended generation, instead of the constrained, artefact-grounded generation that characterizes XAINs. Because an XAIN is grounded in an XAI artefact, that artefact constitutes a ground truth to which the narrative must remain faithful. Fairness in XAINs therefore cannot be assessed on the content of a narrative alone, such as which features it mentions (feature coverage) or which sentiment it contains (sentiment), but must also account for whether narratives accurately translate this ground truth (faithfulness). This introduces a fairness dimension without an analogue in either parent field. Consequently, no framework currently exists to assess disparities in XAINs across social groups ( Mill et al., 2024 ; Silvestri et al., 2025 ) , motivating this work.

blocks.en: 3. Study Design
blocks.zh: 3个 学习设计

blocks.en: In this section, the study design will be presented. First, an overview is given of the datasets and models used to make the predictions and compute the SHAP features for the instances for which the XAINs provide explanations. Second, the choice of generator LLMs and the prompt design are justified. Third, the different generation conditions are laid out. Lastly, the metrics on which social groups will be compared are presented.
blocks.zh: 本节将介绍研究设计。 首先,概述用于预测和计算SHAP特征的数据集和模型,以说明XAIN提供解释的实例。 其次,选择生成器LLM和即时设计是合理的. 第三,规定了不同的生成条件。 最后,介绍了衡量社会群体的衡量标准。

blocks.en: 3.1. Datasets and Models
blocks.zh: 3.1. 数据集和模型

blocks.en: We evaluate our framework on four publicly available datasets drawn from high-risk domains as defined by the EU AI Act ( European Parliament and Council of the European Union, 2024 ) : (i) German Credit ( Hofmann, 1994 ) , recording loan applications from 1970s Germany, for credit scoring; (ii) Saudi Employee Turnover (Saudi HR) ( Alqahtani et al., 2025 ) , collected through a survey of employees of Saudi Arabian private-sector companies, for employment; (iii) Portuguese Student Performance (Student) ( Cortez, 2008 ) , recording secondary-school students of the Portuguese language course at two Portuguese schools; and (iv) Law School Bar Passage (Law) ( Ofer, 2022 ) , drawn from the LSAC National Longitudinal Bar Passage Study ( Wightman, 1998 ) , both for education. For each dataset, a Random Forest (RF) classifier with balanced class weights was trained on an 80/20 train/test split, excluding the protected attributes, to predict (i) bad credit risk, (ii) employee attrition, (iii) failing the final year of school and (iv) failing the bar exam. Each prediction is linked to an adverse decision: an applicant with bad credit risk is denied credit, and, hypothetically, an employee predicted to leave is denied a promotion, a student predicted to fail is assigned mandatory remedial classes, and an applicant predicted to fail the bar exam is rejected for law school admission. Decision thresholds were set to result in enough adversely predicted test instances for statistical analysis. From these, 100 instances per dataset were sampled, spread as evenly as possible over the combinations of protected-attribute groups so that small groups are fully represented. For each sampled instance, SHAP feature attributions were computed with TreeSHAP ( Lundberg and Lee, 2017 ) : a SHAP value quantifies a feature’s effect on the prediction by averaging its contribution across all possible feature combinations. Figure 2 summarises each dataset, its model and the compared groups.
blocks.zh: 我们根据《欧盟AI法》(欧洲议会和欧洲联盟理事会,2024年)界定的高风险领域的四个公开数据集评估我们的框架: (一) 德国信贷(Hofmann,1994年),记录1970年代德国的贷款申请,以获得信贷分数;(二) 沙特雇员转折(Saudi HR)(Alqahtani等,2025年),通过对沙特阿拉伯私营公司雇员的调查收集,以就业;(三) 葡萄牙学生成绩(学生)(Cortez,2008年),记录在两所葡萄牙学校学习葡萄牙语的中学生;(四) 法学院律师传票(Ofer,2022年),均取自LSAC国家纵向律师传票研究(1998年,Wightman)。 对于每个数据集,一个具有平衡班次权重的随机森林(RF)分类器接受了80/20次列车/测试分出(不包括受保护属性)的培训,以预测(一)不良信用风险,(二)员工减员,(三)未能完成最后一学年的学业,(四)未能通过律师资格考试. 每个预测都与不利决定有关:一个信用风险不佳的申请人被拒绝获得信贷,而假设的是,一个预计离职的雇员被拒绝晋升,一个预计失败的学生被分配到强制性的补习班,一个预计失败的律师资格考试的申请人被拒绝进入法学院。 设定了决定阈值,以便作出足够的不利预测,用于统计分析。 从中,对每个数据集的100个实例进行了抽样,尽可能均衡地分布在保护属性组的组合上,以便小组得到充分代表。 对每个样本来说, SHAP 特征归属是通过 TreeSHAP(Lundberg and Lee, 2017)计算出来的: SHAP值通过平均其在所有可能的特征组合中的贡献来量化一个特征对预测的影响. 图2汇总了每个数据集、模型和比较组。

blocks.en: 3.2. Generator LLMs and Prompt Design
blocks.zh: 3.2. 发电机LLM和即时设计

blocks.en: We generate XAINs with five LLMs from three providers: gpt-4.1 and gpt-4o-mini (OpenAI), claude-sonnet-4-6 (Anthropic), and mistral-large-2512 and ministral-14b (Mistral AI). They differ in size, weight availability, and region of origin. An overview is given in Table 5 (Appendix B ). All models are called at temperature T = 0 T=0 to minimise variation between repeated calls and support reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 我们用来自三个供应商的5个LLMs生成XAINs:gpt-4.1和gpt-4o-mini(OpenAI),claude-sonnet-4-6(Anthropic),以及mostral-migr-2512和minidstral-14b(Mistral AI)。 它们的体积、重量和来源区域各不相同。 概览见表5(附录B)。 所有模型在温度T = 0 T = 0时调用,以尽量减少重复调用与支持再生之间的相差.

blocks.en: Each LLM receives an instance-specific prompt, of which the template is given in Fig. 7 in Appendix C . The prompt consists of five parts, preceded by the explanation goal: (i) the dataset context, describing the data and the target variable and stating that the protected attributes were not used by the model; (ii) a description of what SHAP values mean; (iii) the applicant profile, listing each feature value with its description and the average or distribution among the accepted group (the test instances predicted to receive the favourable outcome), followed by the predicted probability and the decision threshold; (iv) the top-3 features ranked by absolute SHAP value, with their SHAP values; and (v) the narrative task, specifying what the narrative must explain, together with constraints on content and style. This prompt structure follows and extends the pipeline proposed by Martens et al. (2025) and similarly used in other works evaluating narratives ( Ichmoukhamedov et al., 2024 ; He and Martens, 2026 ) . One notable difference is the inclusion of feature averages and distributions of the accepted group next to the feature value of the adversely predicted instance. In doing this, we follow He and Martens (2026) and Ichmoukhamedov et al. (2024) , but only include averages and distributions for the accepted group (instead of the dataset as a whole), as this has been deemed of greater relevance.
blocks.zh: 每个 LLM 得到一个特定实例的提示,其中的模板在附录C的图7中给出. 提示由五个部分组成,前有解释目标:(一) 数据集上下文,描述数据和目标变量,并声明模型没有使用被保护属性;(二) 描述SHAP值的含义;(三) 申请人简介,列出每个特征值及其描述以及被接受群体之间的平均值或分布(测试实例预计会得到有利的结果),然后是预测概率和决定阈值;(四) 按SHAP绝对值排名的上至3个特征及其SHAP值;和(五) 叙述任务,具体说明说明必须解释什么,以及对内容和风格的限制. 这种即时结构遵循并延伸了Martens等人(2025年)提出的管道,并类似地用于评价叙述的其他作品(Ichmoukhamedov等人,2024年;He和Martens,2026年)。 一个显著的区别是,在不利预测实例的特征值旁边列入了被接受群体的特点平均值和分布。 在这样做时,我们跟随He和Martens(2026年)和Ichmoukhamedov等人(2024年),但只包括被接受组的平均值和分布(而不是整个数据集),因为这被认为更有意义.

blocks.en: Protected attributes could be included as part of the instance profile passed to the LLM. This choice can be motivated in several ways. First, coherent narrative generation requires access to the underlying feature values: an LLM cannot construct a clear, cause-effect explanatory account of an individual’s situation without knowledge of their actual feature values, to which the inclusion of protected attributes may add. Second, including this information can support personalisation objectives, allowing the narrative to connect model reasoning to the individual’s specific situation rather than producing a generic explanation ( Musicco et al., 2026 ) . Third, in certain application domains (e.g. medical contexts), the disclosure of attributes such as age or sex may be necessary for the explanation to be meaningful or actionable. Finally, preliminary considerations suggest that certain metrics may perform differently depending on whether such attributes are visible to the model ( Van den Bulck et al., 2026 ) . Given these considerations, we treat the disclosure of protected attributes as an experimental variable, as will be detailed in Section 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 受保护的属性可列入移交给LLM的实例配置文件。 这种选择可以有几种动机。 首先,连贯的叙述生成需要获取基本特征值:一个LLM不能在不了解个人实际特征值的情况下,构建一个清晰的、因果解释性的个人状况说明,而将受保护的属性纳入其中可能增加这一说明。 第二,包括这种信息可以支持个性化的目标,使叙述能够将模型推理与个人的具体情况联系起来,而不是产生一般的解释(Musicco等,2026.). 第三,在某些应用领域(如医疗领域),披露年龄或性别等属性可能是解释有意义或可采取行动的必要条件。 最后,初步考虑表明,某些衡量标准可能根据模型是否可见这些属性而有所不同(Van den Bulck等,2026年)。 鉴于这些考虑,我们将保护属性的披露视为一个实验变量,详情见第3.3节。

blocks.zh: 3.3. 生成条件

blocks.en: Building on the XAIN generation pipeline described in Section 2.2 , we vary the prompt’s protected attribute content to isolate distinct sources of disparity. We generate narratives for the adversely classified instances under three conditions, defined by the combination of two prompt-level factors: protected attribute type (factual vs. counterfactual) and protected attribute visibility (disclosed vs. withheld). A factual protected attribute matches the instance’s actual group membership, whereas for a counterfactual protected attribute the entire feature vector is held fixed while the value of the protected attribute is swapped. This gives three generation conditions, illustrated by Figure 3 :

(c) Counterfactual PA disclosed : the protected attribute is disclosed but swapped with another value, with the remaining feature vector held fixed.

blocks.en: Each protected attribute is swapped one at a time to a fixed value of the other group: binary attributes take the other value, ordinal attributes the median of the other group (age: 38 or 25 in German Credit, 31–40 or 21–30 in Saudi HR, 17 or 15 in Student Performance; student health: “very good” or “bad”), and race its most common value (black for white applicants, white for non-white applicants). We define a disparity as a statistically significant difference on any of the metrics introduced in Section 3.4 , between social groups or between generation conditions. Comparing the conditions gives five types of disparity (Figure 3 ):
blocks.zh: 每个被保护的属性一次被交换到另一个组的固定值: 二进制属性取出另一个值,平分属性取出另一个组的中位数(年龄:德国信用38或25分,沙特HR31-40或21-30分,学生表现17或15分;学生健康:"非常好"或"坏")并与其最常见的值相竞争(白人申请人黑,非白人申请人白). 我们把差距定义为第3.4节中引入的任何计量标准、社会群体之间或世代之间统计上的重大差异。 比较条件可以发现五种差异(图3):

blocks.en: – D1: Total disparity : comparing social groups under condition (a) shows whether a disparity exists at all, combining feature-driven and label-driven effects. – D2: Indirect disparity : comparing social groups under condition (b) shows whether a disparity persists when the PAs are hidden from the LLM, attributing the disparity to feature values. – D3: Disclosure disparity : contrasting (a) with (b) within a social group shows whether disclosing the group’s protected attribute changes the narrative. – D4: Direct disparity : contrasting (c) with (a) for the same instance, with only one protected attribute swapped to another value, isolates the effect of the PA value itself. – D5: Value disparity : contrasting (c) with (a) for narratives that display the same PA values, but whose feature values come from different social groups, shows whether the feature values cause a disparity even when the LLM sees the same label. blocks.en: Together, these comparisons detect disparities and isolate their cause: the feature values (D2, D5), the disclosure of the protected attribute (D3), or its value (D4).

blocks.en: 3.4. Metrics

In this section, the metrics on which the comparisons will be made are presented. We compute faithfulness to the underlying XAI artefact (which is the most frequently evaluated criterion ( Silvestri et al., 2025 ) ), feature coverage, and sentiment. A full overview of all (individual) metrics is given in Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,将提出进行比较的尺度。 我们计算出对基本XAI人工活性(这是最常被评价的标准(Silvestri等人,2025年))的忠诚度、特征覆盖率和情绪。 对所有(个人)指标的全面概述见表6。

blocks.en: (i) Faithfulness . The generator LLM is presented with the top X X features based on the absolute SHAP values, with X = 3 X=3 in this study. Following the taxonomy of Silvestri et al. (2025) , the narrative should be accurate and complete in representing the underlying XAI artefact. Accuracy in this context is split into three parts ( Ichmoukhamedov et al., 2024 ) . Value Accuracy (VA) measures whether the stated feature values are correct, Sign Accuracy (SA) whether the direction of each feature’s influence on the prediction is correct, and Rank Accuracy (RA) whether the most important features are presented in the correct order of importance.
blocks.zh: (一) 忠诚。 生成器LLM基于绝对SHAP值呈现出上XX特征,而X=3 3在本研究中. Silvestri等人(2025年)的分类学之后,叙述应准确而完整地代表基本的XAI活性. 在这种情况下准确性被分为三部分(Ichmoukhamedov等,2024.). 价值准确度(VA)衡量所声明的特征值是否正确,Sign Access(SA)衡量每个特征对预测的影响方向是否正确,Rank Access(RA)衡量最重要的特征是否按照正确的重要性顺序呈现.

blocks.en: For SHAP faithfulness, these metrics measure the agreement with the ground-truth values v j ∗ , s j ∗ , r j ∗ v_{j}^{*},s_{j}^{*},r_{j}^{*} , representing the actual feature value, sign and rank of the extracted feature f j f_{j} . For each top- X X feature, a binary indicator records whether the extracted quantity is correct (Table 6 ). Per narrative, these indicators are aggregated into VA, SA and RA, each computed as an accuracy (XA) of the same general form ( Ichmoukhamedov et al., 2024 ) (Equation 1 ), where x j x_{j} denotes the extracted quantity (value, sign, or rank) for feature f j f_{j} , and x j ∗ x_{j}^{*} its ground-truth counterpart. The Kronecker delta δ x j , x j ∗ \delta_{x_{j},x_{j}^{*}} equals 1 if the extracted quantity matches the ground truth and 0 otherwise, so the numerator sums the number of correct matches. The denominator normalizes this count by the number of scored features n n minus those for which no quantity could be identified in the narrative (denoted x j = ϕ x_{j}=\phi ). In other words, XA is the accuracy of the extracted quantity, computed only over features where the narrative provided an extractable value: (1) X ​ A = ∑ x j ≠ ϕ δ x j , x j ∗ n − ∑ x j = ϕ 1 . Value accuracy is scored in the same way for any secondary features (features outside the top- X X SHAP features) and protected attributes the narrative mentions, and the per-narrative VA aggregates all of these. Finally, we also record whether the predicted probability is stated correctly.

blocks.en: (ii) Feature Coverage . In addition to the correctness of the included features, it must be ensured that the narrative includes all that it needs to include. Completeness here is defined as the presence of each of the top- X X SHAP features in the narrative. Likewise, the narrative may include secondary features if the LLM deems these relevant. All features mentioned in the narrative are therefore extracted, and for each feature a binary indicator records whether it is mentioned. This allows for comparisons of completeness (for the top- X X SHAP features) and general feature coverage (for secondary features). The protected attributes are treated separately: since they were excluded from model training, they never carry a SHAP value, and any mention of them is introduced by the LLM itself. Per narrative, we summarize coverage in two proportions: the PA-mention proportion , the share of the dataset’s protected attributes that are mentioned, and the secondary-feature-mention proportion , the share of features outside the top X X that are mentioned.
blocks.zh: (二)特色覆盖. 除了包含的特征的正确性外,还必须确保叙述包括它需要包括的所有内容. 完整性在这里被定义为叙述中每个上-X X SHAP特征的存在. 同样,如果LLM认为这些特点相关,说明可能包括次要特征。 因此,叙述中提到的所有特征都被取出,每个特征都有一个二进制指标记录是否被提及. 这样可以比较完整性(对于上-X X SHAP 特性)和一般特性覆盖(对于次要特性). 受保护的属性被分别处理:由于被排除于模型训练之外,它们从不具有SHAP值,任何提及这些属性的内容都是由LLM本身引入的. 按叙述,我们以两个比例来总结覆盖率:PA-mention比例,被提及的数据集受保护属性的比例,以及被提及的上XX之外特征的比例。

blocks.en: Each metric shows a different way in which narratives could differ between social groups. Faithfulness could differ if LLMs unequally flip the sign of SHAP values they deem “counterintuitive” ( Ichmoukhamedov et al., 2024 ) , or alter feature values to fit their expectations across groups. Feature coverage could differ because LLMs associate social groups with certain characteristics ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , so a protected attribute or a group’s typical profile may change what the LLM deems relevant to mention. Sentiment could differ if the LLM frames groups according to stereotypes it absorbed from its training data ( Gallegos et al., 2024 ) . Whether, and why, each of these occurs is shown in Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 每种衡量标准都显示了一种不同的方式,不同社会群体的叙述可能有所不同。 如果LLMS不平等地翻转他们认为“直觉”的SHAP价值观(Ichmoukhamedov等人,2024年)的标志,或者改变特征值以适应各群体的期望,那么信仰就会不同。 特征覆盖可能有所不同,因为LLMs将社会团体与某些特征联系在一起(Bai等人,2025年),因此受保护的属性或群体的典型特征可能会改变LLM认为相关的内容. 如果LLM框架小组根据其从培训数据中吸收的陈规定型观念(Gallegos等,2024年),其观点可能有所不同。 第4节显示是否以及为什么发生这些事情。

blocks.zh: 3.5. 评价管道

blocks.en:
The faithfulness and feature coverage metrics are computed using the pipeline depicted in Figure 4 .
We adopt an extraction-based evaluation pipeline, in line with earlier works ( Ichmoukhamedov et al., 2024 ; He and Martens, 2026 ) . This pipeline extracts information from each narrative into structured information in JSON format, which can then be compared against the ground truth from the generation prompt.

忠诚度和特征覆盖度的衡量标准用图4所描绘的管道计算。
我们按照先前的工程(Ichmoukhamedov等,2024年;He和Martens,2026年),采用了基于提炼的评估管道。 这个管道从每个叙事中将信息从JSON格式中抽取到结构化的信息中去,然后可以和从生成时起的地面真相进行比较.

blocks.en: Because of budget constraints, all narratives are processed by a single extractor LLM, grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning , which receives the narrative without access to the ground truth its extraction is compared with. We chose an extractor from a provider that generated none of the narratives, as LLMs tend to favour text produced by their own model family. The extraction prompt format is shown in Figure 8 . To validate the extractor, we manually checked the extractions of 100 randomly sampled narratives (five per generator LLM and dataset). The extraction was fully correct for 94 narratives, the six errors (three values, one sign, one top-3 selection and one missed probability) were spread across generator LLMs, showed no pattern by social group, and are in line with earlier research ( Ichmoukhamedov et al., 2024 ) . For every statistically significant disparity (Section 4 ), we verified that no extraction errors were made. The remaining risk is that the extractor misses errors, which could hide disparities, although Ichmoukhamedov et al. (2024) found such misses to never occur.

blocks.en: 4. Results
blocks.zh: 4.四. 结果

blocks.en: Results are presented per metric family: faithfulness, feature coverage and sentiment. For each, we first describe the general picture and then the differences between social groups. To locate where a difference comes from, we use the five disparity comparisons of Section 3.3 (D1–D5): a total disparity (D1) shows that groups differ, and the other four show whether this is due to the feature values (D2, D5), the disclosure of the protected attribute (D3) or its value (D4). Inspecting the narratives behind each disparity then reveals the LLM behaviour that produces it. Each metric was tested separately per dataset and generator LLM, and further per protected attribute (D1, D2), per social group (D3) or per counterfactual swap (D4, D5), using two-sided tests that match each design: independent-group tests for D1 and D2 (Appendix A.2 ), paired tests for D3 and D4 (Appendix A.3 ) and stratified tests for D5 (Appendix A.4 ). Raw p p -values were corrected with the Benjamini–Hochberg procedure ( α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 ) within batches that keep binary and continuous metrics apart (Appendix A.1 , Table 4 ). Only results that remain significant after this correction are reported as findings.
blocks.zh: 成果按衡量的家庭列出:忠诚、特征覆盖面和情感。 对于每一个,我们首先描述总体情况,然后描述社会群体之间的差异。 为了找到不同之处,我们使用第3.3节(D1-D5)的五个差异比较:一个总差异(D1)显示各组不同,另外四个显示这是否是由于特征值(D2,D5),受保护属性(D3)的披露或其值(D4). 检查每个差异背后的叙述,就会发现产生这种差异的LLM行为. 每个度量衡每个数据集和生成器LLM分别进行测试,每个被保护的属性(D1,D2),每个社会群体(D3)或每个反事实交换(D4,D5)进一步进行测试,采用与每个设计相匹配的双面测试:D1和D2的独立分组测试(附录A.2),D3和D4的对接测试(附录A.3)和D5的分层测试(附录A.4). Benjamini-Hochberg程序(α = 0.05\alpha = 0.05)将原始p - 值校正为将二进制和连续计量分开的批次(附录A.1,表4)。 只有经过这次更正后仍具有重大意义的结果才报告为调查结果。

blocks.en: For brevity, this section focuses on the most notable findings, but all significant findings are to be found in Tables 7 , 8 and 9 . Across all three metrics, two ways in which disparities occur emerge. Faithfulness disparities arise from the feature values: the LLM makes errors that are blind to the social group but triggered by values that are unequally distributed across groups. Disparities in feature coverage and sentiment arise mainly from the protected attribute itself: whether it is disclosed, and which value it takes, changes the narrative’s content.
blocks.zh: 简言之,本节着重介绍最显著的调查结果,但所有重要的调查结果载于表7、表8和表9。 在所有三个衡量标准中,出现差异的两种方式。 信仰差异产生于特征值: LLM 出错对社会群体是盲目的,但由各群体分布不均的价值观所引发. 特征覆盖和情绪的差异主要出自被保护的属性本身:它是否被披露,以及它需要何种价值,都会改变叙述的内容.

blocks.en: 4.1. Faithfulness
4.1.1. General picture

Faithfulness follows model cost (Table 1 and Table 5 ; tests in Appendix A.5 ). The two most expensive models are the most faithful: claude-sonnet-4-6 leads on sign and rank accuracy, gpt-4.1 on value accuracy. The two small models trail far behind, especially on sign accuracy (71–76%). The fewest mistakes are made for value accuracy: every model states at least 90% of feature values correctly on every dataset. The predicted probability of the adverse outcome is stated correctly in all narratives, except for ministral-14b on Saudi HR (90.5%).
blocks.zh: 可靠性遵循模型成本(表1和表5;附录A.5中的测试)。 两个最昂贵的模型是最忠实的:Claude-sonnet-4-6领先于标志和分级精度,gpt-4.1领先于值精度. 两个小模型远远落后,特别是在标志精确度(71–76 %)方面. 在数值准确性方面犯错误最少:每个模型在每个数据集上至少正确表示90%的特征值. 除了沙特HR上的迷你至14b(90.5%)外,所有叙述中都正确表述了不良结果的预测概率.

blocks.en: German Credit has the lowest average sign accuracy, mainly because three SHAP-favourable values sound unfavourable, but aren’t: no checking account, no or unknown savings, and a “critical” credit history (43% of its sign errors). gpt-4o-mini never describes them correctly ( claude-sonnet-4-6 , gpt-4.1 : 80–94%). This illustrates the most frequent kind of error, which we call a plausible falsehood : a statement that sounds reasonable but contradicts the SHAP artefact. Most commonly, a favourable feature (one pushing toward the favourable outcome) is presented as a reason for the adverse decision, which accounts for 86% of all sign errors. Smaller models more often include these plausible falsehoods : 51–59% of favourable features are described this way, in comparison with 3% for claude-sonnet-4-6 . Mistakes against the rank accuracy are mostly reorderings of the correct top-3 SHAP features (82%). Including a secondary feature into the top three also happens almost exclusively in the smallest two models (91% of cases).
blocks.zh: 德国信用公司的平均标志准确度最低,这主要是因为三种SHAP的有利价值听起来是不利的,但并不是:没有支票账户、没有或未知的储蓄以及“关键”信用历史(占其标志错误的43%)。 gpt-4o-mini从来没有正确描述过它们(claude-sonnet-4-6,gpt-4.1:80–94%). 这说明了最常发生的错误,我们称之为一种假象:一种听起来合理但与SHAP动画相矛盾的说法。 最常见的情况是,一个有利特征(一个推动有利结果)被提出来作为作出不利决定的理由,占所有标志错误的86%。 更小的模型往往包括这些假象:51-59%的有利特征被这样描述,而Claude-sonnet-4-6的有利特征为3%。 与分级准确性相差错的多为正确上至3 SHAP特征的重排(82%). 将次要特征列入前三部分几乎完全发生在最小的两个模型中(91%的案例)。

blocks.en: 4.1.2. Differences between social groups
blocks.zh: 4.1.2. 社会群体之间的差异

blocks.en: None of the 19 faithfulness disparities (as shown in Table 7 ) occur in claude-sonnet-4-6 or gpt-4.1 , mainly because they correctly handle the cases that cause disparities in smaller models, so many metrics are correct for every narrative and disparities between social groups do not show up.
blocks.zh: 19个信众差距(如表7所示)中没有一个发生在claude-sonnet-4-6或gpt-4.1中,这主要是因为他们正确处理了在较小模型中造成差距的案件,因此许多衡量尺度对每个叙述都是正确的,社会群体之间的差别没有出现.

blocks.en: In the smaller models, all disparities follow the same plausible falsehood principle. Errors are triggered by particular feature values, but because these values are unequally distributed across groups, so are by extension the errors. By inspecting the narratives that include these errors, we identify two mechanisms: (i) the LLM’s prior expectations override the artefact, or (ii) the LLM bends the facts to justify the adverse decision.
blocks.zh: 在较小的模型中,所有差异都遵循同样的假象原则。 出错由特定特征值所触发,但由于这些值在组别之间分布不均,因此由此推论出错. 通过检查包含这些错误的叙述,我们找出了两种机制:(一) LLM的先前期望压倒了动脉,或(二) LLM弯曲事实为不利决定辩护.

blocks.en: (i) The clearest case is the work experience feature in Saudi HR: 1–5 years of experience is favourable in every instance, yet gpt-4o-mini reverses this in 37 of 39 cases, reasoning that greater experience “correlates with stability and commitment” . As 53% of women hold 1–5 years of experience against 26% of men, and 69% of employees aged 21–30 against 16% of those aged 31+, the sign of the most important feature is correct for only 37% of women against 70% of men (D1, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.019 p_{FDR}=0.019 ), and for 34% of young against 67% of older employees (D1, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.024 p_{FDR}=0.024 ). The decomposition confirms that the feature values, not the protected attribute, drive this: relabelling young employees as older leaves their accuracy unchanged (34% to 32%; D4, p = 1.0 p=1.0 ), while their profiles still fall far behind those of actually older employees (31% against 68%; D5, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.026 p_{FDR}=0.026 ). Similarly, gpt-4o-mini ranks checking-account status first in German Credit regardless of its SHAP rank, seemingly following domain expectation. As women less often have this as their actual top feature (38% against 57%), their top feature is identified correctly less often (65% against 90%; D1, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.040 p_{FDR}=0.040 ).
blocks.zh: (一) 最明显的例子是沙特人力资源中的工作经验:在每一个案例中,1至5年的经验都是有利的,但是在39个案例中,有37个案例的gpt-4o-mini倒置了这一点,其理由是,更大的经验 " 与稳定和承诺相关 " 。 由于53%的妇女拥有1至5年的经验,而男子拥有26%的经验,21至30岁的雇员拥有69%的经验,31岁以上雇员拥有16%的经验,因此,最重要的特征是,只有37%的妇女拥有70%的经验(D1,pFDR=0.019,p_{FDR=0.019),34%的年轻人拥有67%的老年雇员拥有这种经验。 (D1,p F D R = 0.024 p_{FDR}=0.024). 分解证实特征值而非被保护的属性驱动着这一点:将年轻员工重新贴上年长员工的标签使其准确性保持不变(34%至32%;D4,p = 1.0 p= 1.0),而他们的配置仍然远远落后于实际年长员工的配置(31%至68%;D5,p F D R = 0.026 p_{FDR}=0.026). 同样,gpt-4o-mini在德国信用排名中排名第一,无论其SHAP级别如何,似乎都遵循了域预期. 由于妇女较少将其作为她们的实际最高特征(38%对57%),她们的最高特征被正确确定为较少(65%对90%;D1,pFD R=0.040 p_{FDR=0.040)。

blocks.en: (ii) When nothing in the prompt seems to support the adverse outcome, the LLM invents a reason. In 33% of Student Performance instances, all three top SHAP features push toward passing, and both ministral-14b and mistral-large-2512 then wrongly turn favourable features into risks, e.g. “your record shows you’ve faced challenges in the past” for students without a single failed class. Students in poor health are more often in this situation (44% against 25%), producing an indirect disparity ( mistral-large-2512 : 92% against 83%; D2, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.044 p_{FDR}=0.044 ; ministral-14b : 75% against 56%; D2, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.045 p_{FDR}=0.045 ). In Saudi HR, gpt-4o-mini goes further and replaces an employee’s value with the most common value among accepted employees, then adapts the explanation to fit: employees with outside job offers are told they “have had limited external offers” , which “might suggest a lack of confidence in your current role” . This behaviour becomes more frequent when the protected attributes are withheld (20 against 6 of 38 cases). Women and employees aged 21–30 are affected most: their value accuracy is lower when the protected attributes are withheld than when they are disclosed (women: 84.2% against 95.6%; aged 21–30: 81.5% against 94.8%; D3, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.010 p_{FDR}=0.010 and 0.025 0.025 ).
blocks.zh: (二) 当瞬间似乎没有任何东西支持不利结果时,LLM就创造了一个理由. 在33%的学生表演中,SHAP的所有三个顶级特征都推向过路,而微型-14b和微型-大型-2512则错误地将有利特征转化为风险,例如: 「你的纪录显示你过去曾面临挑战」, 健康不佳的学生更常见于这种情况(44%对25 % ) , 产生了间接差异(误差-大-2512:92%对83 % ; D2,pFD R = 0.044 p-FDR-0.044;迷你-14b:75%对56 % ; D2,pFD R = 0.045 p-FDR-±0.045 ) 。 在沙特人力资源中,gpt-4o-mini更进一步,用被接受的雇员中最常见的价值取代了雇员的价值,然后调整解释:有外部工作机会的雇员被告知“外部报价有限 ” , “ 这“可能表明人们对你目前的角色缺乏信心 ” 。 当受保护的属性被扣留(38个案件中有6个)时,这种行为变得更加频繁。 21-30岁的妇女和雇员受影响最大:当受保护的属性被扣时,其价值准确度低于披露时(妇女:84.2%,95.6%;21-30岁:81.5%,94.8%;D3,pFD R=0.010)。 p_{FDR}=0.010和0.025 0.025.

blocks.en: Taken together, faithfulness disparities mostly (but not exclusively, see Table 7 ) disadvantage women and young employees, and are driven by feature values, not by the protected attributes. We show that withholding the protected attributes therefore does not remove them (D2), and changing their value hardly matters (D4). Whether the protected attributes are disclosed can even make things worse, in either direction: withholding them made gpt-4o-mini fabricate more values for women and young employees, while disclosing them made ministral-14b misstate the experience sign more often for young employees.
blocks.zh: 归根结底,忠诚的差别主要(但并非完全如此,见表7)使妇女和年轻雇员处于不利地位,而是由特征价值而不是受保护的属性驱动的。 因此,我们显示,扣取受保护属性并不去除这些属性(D2),改变其价值几乎没有关系(D4)。 是否披露受保护的属性甚至会使情况恶化,无论是从哪方面来说都是如此:扣留这些属性使得gpt-4o-mini为妇女和青年雇员制造了更多的价值,而披露这些属性则使得迷你14b更经常地错误地描述年轻雇员的经历标志。

blocks.en: 4.2. Feature Coverage
blocks.zh: 4.2. 特征覆盖

blocks.en: 4.2.1. General picture

All models mention nearly all top-3 SHAP features, and therefore produce complete XAINs (Table 2 ). Only the two small models occasionally forget one, most often in German Credit (91.0–94.7%). Protected attributes are rarely mentioned (1.1–6.8%), and outside of Student Performance, 45 of 46 mentions are non-discrimination disclaimers saying that the protected attributes were not used by the predictive model. In addition to these disclaimers, protected attributes are mentioned only in Student Performance for the health feature: narratives from gpt-4o-mini , ministral-14b and mistral-large-2512 use the student’s health in the explanation, either presenting poor health as a cause or good health as a strength, although the prompt states that health was not used by the predictive model.
blocks.zh: 所有型号都提到了几乎所有的顶级-3 SHAP 特性,因此产生了完整的 XAIN (表2.). 只有两个小模型偶尔会忘记一个,最常见的是在"德意志信用"(91.0–94.7%). 受保护的属性很少被提及(1.1–6.8%),在学生表演之外,46个提及中有45个是不歧视的否认者,表示受保护的属性没有被预测模型所使用. 除了这些免责声明之外,保护的属性只在学生表演中被提及健康特征:从gpt-4o-mini,micstral-14b和mistral-large-2512的叙述在解释中使用了学生的健康,要么将健康不佳作为原因,要么将健康良好作为力量,尽管即刻声明健康没有被预测模型所使用.

blocks.en: 4.2.2. Differences between social groups
blocks.zh: 4.2.2. 社会群体之间的差异

blocks.en: Unlike faithfulness, significant differences in feature coverage also occurred in claude-sonnet-4-6 , accounting for 17 of the 34 findings, all summarised in Table 8 . Here, disparities are mainly driven by the protected attribute itself, through its value and its disclosure. We identify two mechanisms: (i) the protected attribute prompts the model to talk about the attribute itself, or (ii) favourable feature values are brought in as strengths.
blocks.zh: 与忠诚不同,在Claude-sonnet-4-6中也出现了显著的特征覆盖范围差异,占34项调查结果中的17项,所有结果摘要见表8。 在这方面,差异主要由受保护的属性本身通过它的价值和披露所驱动。 我们确定了两种机制:(一) 受保护属性促使模型谈论属性本身,或(二) 将有利的特征价值作为优势引入。

blocks.en: (i) When a protected attribute is disclosed, some models comment on it, and how often depends on its value. claude-sonnet-4-6 adds non-discrimination disclaimers in Law ( “It is important to note that your gender and race played no role in this decision” ) far more often for non-white than for white applicants (38% against 12%; D1, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.016 p_{FDR}=0.016 ), and most often for Hispanic applicants (60%). This is not explained by their higher predicted failure risk, but by the race value itself: relabelling non-white applicants as white reduces it from 38% to 10% (D4, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.012 p_{FDR}=0.012 ). In Student Performance, gpt-4o-mini mentions health almost only when it is poor (27.9% against 1.8%; D1, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.003 p_{FDR}=0.003 ). Nearly half of these mentions claim that health affects the outcome, e.g. “your current health status is rated as very bad, which can significantly affect your ability to focus and perform well in school” , although the prompt states that health was not used by the model. For these students, including the bad health label raises health mentions from 2% to 44% (D4, p F ​ D ​ R < 0.001 p_{FDR}<0.001 ). In both cases, withholding the protected attributes removes the mentions almost entirely (D3). The PA mentions bring another disadvantage, as they take up space. Within the 250-word limit, claude-sonnet-4-6 ’s Law narratives that contain a non-discrimination disclaimer mention fewer secondary features (10.7% against 23.6% without one). As a result, non-white applicants, who receive them most, get less explanation when race is disclosed: their narratives mention 14.7% of the secondary features on average, against 28.0% when race is withheld (D3, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.025 p_{FDR}=0.025 ).
blocks.zh: (一)当一个被保护的属性被披露时,一些模型对此进行评论,以及在多大程度上经常取决于其价值. Claude-sonnet-4-6在法律中增加了不歧视的免责声明(“必须指出,你的性别和种族在这一决定中没有起到任何作用”),对于非白人申请人来说,比对于白人申请人来说,更常见(38%对12%;D1,pF D R=0.016 p_{FDR}=0.016),最常见的是西班牙裔申请人(60%)。 在学生表现方面,gpt-4o-mini只提到贫穷的健康状况(27.9%对1.8%;D1,pFDR = 0.003对FDR-0.003),其中近一半提到健康会影响结果。 “你的目前健康状况被评为非常糟糕,这可大大地影响你在学校中集中注意力和表现良好的能力”,不过,该评语指出,模型没有使用健康。 对这些学生来说,包括不良健康标签将健康提法从2%提高到44%(D4,pFDR < 0.001 p_{FDR=0.001)。 在这两种情况下,扣取被保护属性几乎完全去除提及(D3)。 巴勒斯坦权力机构提到在占用空间时又造成另一个不利因素。 在250个字限制内,Claude-sonnet-4-6的法律说明中包含不歧视的免责条款提到次要特征较少(10.7%对23.6%没有次要特征)。 因此,收到最多的非白人申请人在种族披露时得到的解释较少:他们的叙述平均提到14.7%的次要特征,而当种族被扣时则提到28.0%(D3,pF D R=0.025 p_{FDR}=0.025.

blocks.en: (ii) Some disparities follow from the applicant’s profile: models tend to mention a secondary feature when its value is favourable. In Law, an undergraduate GPA above the accepted average is mentioned in 45% of narratives against 25% when below it, and women more often have such a GPA. Men’s profiles labelled as female receive far fewer GPA mentions than actual women ( claude-sonnet-4-6 : 13% against 54%; D5, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.022 p_{FDR}=0.022 ; gpt-4o-mini : 3% against 43%; D5, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.013 p_{FDR}=0.013 ), confirming that the label does not cause this. Similarly, with age withheld, gpt-4o-mini mentions more secondary features for older German Credit applicants (3.1% against 1.0%; D2, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.042 p_{FDR}=0.042 ), mostly employment duration and credit history, which tend to be longer for older applicants.
blocks.zh: (二) 从申请人的特征来看,存在一些差异:模型往往在价值有利时提到次要特征。 在法律中,45%的叙述中提到了高于公认平均水平的本科GPA,低于25%的叙述中则提到了这一水平,妇女往往拥有这种GPA。 男性被称为女性的特征比实际女性要少得多(Claude-sonnet-4-6:13%对54%;D5,pF D R = 0.022 p = FDR = 0.022 p;gpt-4o-mini:3%对43%;D5,pF D R = 0.013 p = + FDR = 0.013),证实标签没有造成这种情况。 同样,由于年龄被扣,gpt-4o-mini提到较年长的德国信贷申请者的次级特征(3.1%对1.0%;D2,pFD R=0.042 p_{FDR-0.042),大多是就业期限和信贷历史,对较年长的申请者来说往往更长.

blocks.en: Coverage disparities thus mostly (but not exclusively, see Table 8 ) disadvantage non-white applicants, who receive more non-discrimination disclaimers at the cost of secondary feature mentions, and students in poor health, who are wrongly told that their health negatively affects the outcome. Unlike faithfulness disparities, they are driven mainly by the protected attributes. Withholding the protected attributes therefore removes these disparities, leaving only those driven by feature values, when these values seem favourable.
blocks.zh: 因此,覆盖范围差距大多(但并非完全见表8)使非白人申请人处于不利地位,他们以次要特征为代价获得更多的不歧视的免责声明,而健康状况不佳的学生则被错误地告知他们的健康状况对结果产生了不利影响。 与忠诚的差别不同,它们主要是由受保护的属性所驱动的. 因此,如果保留受保护的属性,就会消除这些差异,而只有那些由特征价值驱动的属性,而这些价值似乎是有利的。

blocks.en: 4.3. Sentiment
4.3.1. General picture

All narratives have a positive net sentiment on average (Table 3 ), despite explaining an adverse decision. claude-sonnet-4-6 and gpt-4.1 write the most positive narratives averaged across all datasets (0.41 and 0.40), the two small models the least positive (0.29–0.30). Even though Saudi HR applicants have a higher predicted risk (0.64 against 0.48), German Credit narratives are the most negative (0.16 on average) and Saudi HR narratives the most positive (0.49). This difference seems due to the dataset’s vocabulary: features and the wording of the predicted outcome count as sentiment words, such as risk in German Credit (from “bad credit risk”, 2.4 times per narrative) or commitment and stability in Saudi HR. As sentiment is only compared within a dataset, this does not affect our results.
blocks.zh: 所有叙事平均都有正面的净情绪(表3),尽管解释了一个负面的决定。 claude-sonnet-4-6和gpt-4.1将所有数据集平均最正面的叙述写出(0.41和0.40),两个小模型最不正面(0.29-0.30)。 尽管沙特人力资源申请人的预测风险较高(0.64比0.48),但德国信贷说明最负面(平均为0.16),沙特人力资源说明最正面(0.49)。 这种差异似乎是由于数据集的词汇:预测结果的特征和措辞算作情绪用词,例如德国信用的风险(来自"不良信用风险",每个叙述2.4倍)或沙特HR的承诺和稳定性. 由于情绪只在数据集中进行比较,这不影响我们的结果。

blocks.en: 4.3.2. Differences between social groups
blocks.zh: 4.3.2. 社会群体之间的差异

blocks.en: Six sentiment disparities survive FDR correction, driven mainly by the protected attribute. The common pattern seems to be that when the disclosed PA marks a group commonly associated with higher risk in that domain, the narrative shifts towards a sentiment of risk and failure.
blocks.zh: 六个情绪差异在FDR修正后得以幸存,这主要是由被保护的属性所驱动. 共同的模式似乎是,当披露的巴勒斯坦权力机构标出通常与该领域较高风险有关的群体时,叙述会转向一种风险和失败感。

blocks.en: The clearest case is gpt-4.1 in Student Performance, where boys receive less positive narratives than girls (0.37 against 0.44; D1, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.011 p_{FDR}=0.011 ). The disclosed sex value drives this: the disparity disappears when sex is withheld (D2, p = 0.34 p=0.34 ), relabelling girls as boys lowers their sentiment to the level of actual boys (0.44 to 0.36; D4, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.002 p_{FDR}=0.002 ), and girls’ and boys’ profiles that are both labelled as boys receive the same sentiment (D5, p = 0.74 p=0.74 ). Age works the same way: gpt-4o-mini writes more negatively for older German Credit applicants once they are presented as 25 years old (0.04 to − 0.03 -0.03 ; D4, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.048 p_{FDR}=0.048 ), and mistral-large-2512 writes more negatively for younger students in Student Performance once their age is disclosed (0.42 to 0.29; D3, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.025 p_{FDR}=0.025 ). Labelling students’ health as bad lowers gpt-4o-mini ’s sentiment in Student Performance (0.44 to 0.38; D4, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.005 p_{FDR}=0.005 ), but only in narratives that bring up their health (0.50 to 0.39), not in those that do not (0.40 to 0.38).
blocks.zh: 最明显的事例是学生成绩中的gpt-4.1, 男孩得到的叙事比女孩少(0.37对0.44;D1,pFD R = 0.011 p_{FDR}=0.011). 被披露的性价值促使了这一点:当性别被扣下时,差距就消失(D2,p= 0.34 p= 0.34),将女孩重新贴上男孩的标签,使其情绪降低到实际男孩的水平(0.44至0.36;D4,pFDR = 0.002 p_{FDR}=0.002),将女孩和男孩的叙事都贴上男孩的标签(D5,p= 0.74 p= 0.74)。 年龄相同:gpt-4o-mini为年长的德国信贷申请人写作时,一旦他们25岁(0.04至0.03至0.03;D4,pFD R = 0.048 p_{FDR = 0.008-0.048),对年长的德国信贷申请人来说,gpt-4o-mini写作更为负面;而错误的-2512为年学生成绩写作更为负面(0.42至0.29;D3,pFD R = 0.025 p_{FDR = 0.008;D4,pFD R = 0.005 p_{DR-0.005),但只写在引起学生健康的叙述中(0.50至0.39),而不是写在没有(0.40至0.38)的叙述中。

blocks.en: One disparity stems from feature values instead: ministral-14b writes more negatively for women’s German Credit profiles, even when they are labelled as male (0.03 against 0.12 for actual men; D5, p F ​ D ​ R = 0.004 p_{FDR}=0.004 ). This difference persists when controlling for predicted risk. Part of it could result from women more often having a negative checking-account balance (48% against 30%), which ministral-14b tends to describe harshly ( “your checking account balance was negative, which is a red flag” ), but most of the gap remains unexplained.
blocks.zh: 一个差异来自特征值:小型至14b为妇女的德国信贷状况写得更负面,即使她们被贴上男性的标签(实际男子0.03比0.12;D5,pF D R=0.004 p_{FDR=0.004)。 在控制预测的风险时,这种差异依然存在。 部分原因可能是妇女经常出现负面的支票账户余额(48%对30%),而微型14b往往用严厉的描述(“你的支票账户余额是负的,是一面红旗”,但大多数缺口仍未解释。

blocks.en: Taken together, sentiment disparities disadvantage groups that are commonly associated with worse outcomes in the domain. Once their protected attribute is disclosed, boys and students in poor health (in education), and young applicants (in credit scoring) receive a more negative sentiment in their narratives. The exception is ministral-14b , which writes more negatively for women’s credit profiles, through their feature values only.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,情绪差异使通常与该领域更糟糕的结果有关的群体处于不利地位。 一旦他们受保护的属性被披露,健康状况不佳的男孩和学生(在教育方面)和年轻申请者(在信用评分方面)在叙述中会得到更负面的情绪. 妇女信贷概况的写法更为负面,

blocks.en: 4.4. Synthesis

Significant disparities occur in all four datasets, in all three metric families and for all five models. The three metric families all reveal that the LLM’s expectations can disregard the input. In faithfulness, expectations about features override the SHAP artefact. In feature coverage and sentiment, expectations about social groups determine whose protected attributes are brought up, how much room is left for secondary features and how the narrative is framed, while feature values determine which secondary features are mentioned. Across all metrics, the disparities mostly disadvantage women (as employees and credit applicants), younger people (as employees, credit applicants and students), boys (as students), non-white law school applicants and students in poor health, though not exclusively.
blocks.zh: 所有四个数据集、所有三个度量家庭以及所有五个模型都存在重大差异。 三个标准家庭都显示LLM的期望会忽略投入。 在忠诚中,对特征的期待超越了SHAP的外观. 在特征覆盖和情感方面,对社会群体的期望决定了哪些受保护的属性被提出,为次要特征留下了多少空间以及如何设定叙述,而特征值则决定提及哪些次要特征。 在所有衡量标准中,这些差异主要使妇女(作为雇员和申请信贷者)、年轻人(作为雇员、申请信贷者和学生)、男孩(作为学生)、非白人法律学校申请人和健康状况不佳的学生处于不利地位,尽管并非完全如此。

blocks.en: 5. Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 讨论情况

blocks.en: Our results show that LLMs include their own expectations in the XAINs, about features in faithfulness and about social groups in feature coverage and sentiment. This is in line with earlier observations: Ichmoukhamedov et al. (2024) found that LLMs “correct” counterintuitive SHAP signs toward intuitive directions, and Silvestri et al. (2025) warn that narratives may favour fluency over faithfulness. These mistakes are not harmless. Because the values that trigger them are unequally distributed, they translate into disparities between social groups.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,LLMs在XAINs中包含了他们自己的期望,关于忠诚的特征和关于社会群体的特征覆盖和情绪。 这与早先的观察是一致的:Ichmoukhamedov等人(2024年)发现,LLMS“正确”反直觉的SHAP指向直觉方向,Silvestri等人(2025年)警告说,叙事可能倾向于流利而不是忠诚。 这些错误并非无害。 由于触发它们的价值观分布不均,它们会转化为社会群体之间的不平等.

blocks.en: We find that withholding the protected attributes, a form of fairness through unawareness ( Dwork et al., 2012 ) , can remove label-driven feature coverage and sentiment disparities, but not the feature-driven faithfulness disparities, and can even introduce new errors. The direct comparison (D4), which applies the logic of counterfactual fairness ( Kusner et al., 2017 ) to XAINs, makes this distinction visible. Only changing the protected attribute value hardly affects faithfulness, but changes PA and secondary feature mention rates, and the sentiment of the narrative.
blocks.zh: 我们发现保留受保护的属性(Dwork et al.,2012年)是一种通过无知实现公平的形式,可以去除由标签驱动的特征覆盖和情绪差异,但不能去除由特征驱动的忠诚差异,甚至可以引入新的错误. 将反事实公平逻辑(Kusner等,2017年)应用到XAINs的直接比较(D4)使得这种区别明显可见. 只有改变受保护的属性价值,才不会影响忠诚,而是改变PA和次要特征的提及率以及叙述的情绪。

blocks.en: Furthermore, faithfulness follows model cost: the two most expensive models show no faithfulness disparities, as they barely make mistakes in the first place. Fairness in faithfulness in XAINs thus partly becomes something that can be bought, raising an equity concern: institutions with fewer resources, or those that prefer small self-hosted models for data protection, may offer their applicants less faithful explanations. As models improve, faithfulness is likely to keep improving, shifting the focus of fairness research in XAINs toward feature coverage and sentiment, where even the most faithful and expensive models show disparities. The two mitigations are thus complementary: a more faithful model removes the feature-driven faithfulness disparities, and withholding the protected attributes mostly removes the label-driven coverage and sentiment disparities, but neither does both. Only their combination, the two most expensive models with the protected attributes withheld, showed no significant disparity between social groups in this study. This may seem the fairest configuration, but it has limits: it relies on the most expensive models, it sacrifices personalisation, and smaller differences than our sample can detect are not ruled out. It also raises the question of what a fair explanation is in the context of XAINs in the first place, which some findings show.
blocks.zh: 此外,忠诚还遵循模型成本:两个最昂贵的模型没有显示忠诚的差别,因为它们一开始几乎没有犯错误. 因此,XAINs中诚信的公平性部分地成为了可以买到的东西,引起了股权问题:资源较少的机构,或者那些更喜欢小型的自我托管数据保护模型的机构,可能会为申请人提供不太忠实的解释. 随着模型的改进,忠诚度有可能不断提高,将XAINs公平研究的重点转向特色覆盖和情绪,即使最忠实和最昂贵的模型也显示出差距。 两种缓解因此是互补的:一种更忠实的模型可以去除由特征驱动的忠诚相差,而扣取被保护的属性大多可以去除由标签驱动的覆盖和情绪相差,但两者都不是. 只有这两种模式的组合,即两个最昂贵的、具有受保护属性的模型,在本研究中显示,各社会群体之间没有明显的差异。 这也许是最公平的配置,但它有限度:它依赖于最昂贵的模型,它牺牲个性化,比我们样本所能发现的更小的差异不排除. 它还提出了一个问题,即最初在XAINs的背景下,什么是公平的解释,一些调查结果表明了这一点。

blocks.en: First, not every significant difference in XAIN content between social groups is unfair by definition as they may reflect genuine differences in the underlying feature values: a narrative that mentions a woman’s strong GPA personalises the explanation, whereas a disclaimer triggered by race does not. Distinguishing legitimate personalisation from bias requires further conceptual work, but the decomposition used in this study already draws a clear line. Differences that are driven by the feature values of the profile (D5) can be legitimate, differences driven by the PA label alone (D3, D4) generally are not. Second, equal treatment of groups by the LLM is not sufficient. The plausible falsehoods behind faithfulness disparities are blind to the social group, yet disadvantage some groups more through their feature values distribution. Third, an XAIN has limited length, so any content added to it displaces explanation. A disparity in seemingly harmless content, such as the non-discrimination disclaimers non-white applicants received more often, thus becomes a disparity in how much of their own situation is explained. This concern related to length limits is specific to fairness in XAINs, without analogue in the fields of fairness in XAI or fairness in NLP.
blocks.zh: 首先,并非各社会群体之间在XAIN内涵上的每一显著差别,顾名思义都是不公平的,因为它们可能反映基本特征价值的真正差别:提到妇女强烈的GPA的叙述使解释成为个性化的,而种族引起的否认声明则不是。 将合理的个性化与偏见区分开来需要进一步的概念工作,但本研究中使用的分解已经划出一条明确的界限. 由剖面图(D5)的特征值所驱动的差异可能是正当的,仅由PA标签(D3,D4)所驱动的差异一般不是. 第二,《法律改革法》对群体给予平等待遇是不够的。 忠诚差距背后的假象对社会群体是盲目的,但某些群体因其特征价值分布而更加处于不利地位。 第三,XAIN的长度有限,因此任何添加的内容都会取代解释. 似乎无害的内容存在差异,例如非白人申请人得到的不歧视免责声明更为频繁,因此,在解释他们自身情况时,存在差异。 有关长度限制的这种关切是XAINs中特有的公平,在XAI中没有类似,在NLP中也没有公平。

blocks.en: Our findings have implications for auditors, XAIN providers, researchers and regulators. For auditors, fairness in translating the XAI artefact into an XAIN should be audited separately from the predictive model or XAI artefact, as a fair model or artefact can still be translated unfairly. Audits should generate narratives under all three conditions, as the five disparity types follow from them without further generations, and only together can they tell whether differences originate from the PA value, its disclosure or the applicants’ profiles. For XAIN providers, LLMs should be chosen for faithfulness, with feature coverage and tone tested separately. Because removing the PAs from the prompt mostly removes label-driven disparities, but leaves the feature-driven faithfulness disparities in place, and can even introduce new errors in less faithful models, withholding the PAs should not be relied upon on its own. For researchers, XAIN evaluation should include counterintuitive feature values and adverse cases without supporting features, and sentiment metrics should be added to existing quality taxonomies ( Silvestri et al., 2025 ) . For regulators, the right to a “clear and meaningful explanation” under Article 86 of the AI Act ( European Parliament and Council of the European Union, 2024 ) says nothing about explanation differences across social groups. This is problematic as our results show that the explanations themselves can differ harmfully between groups in a multitude of ways.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果对审计师、XAIN提供者、研究人员和监管机构都有影响。 对审计人员来说,将XAI蒿素转化成XAIN的公正性应与预测模型或XAI蒿素分开审计,因为公平模型或蒿素的翻译仍然不公平。 审计应在所有三个条件下产生叙述,因为五种差异类型都是从这些差异中产生的,而代代相传,它们只能共同判断差异来自巴勒斯坦权力机构的价值、披露价值还是申请人的情况。 对于 XAIN 供应商,LLMs 应为忠诚而选择,特色覆盖范围和音调分别测试. 由于将PA从快取出大多消除了由标签驱动的差异,但留下了由特征驱动的忠诚差异,甚至可能在不太忠实的模型中引入出新的错误,所以扣压PA不应该依靠自己. 对研究人员而言,XAIN评价应当包括反直观特征值和没有辅助特征的不良案例,并且在现有质量分类中应当增加情绪度量(Silvestri等,2025年)。 对监管者来说,根据《大赦国际法》第86条(欧洲议会和欧洲联盟理事会,2024年)获得“明确和有意义的解释”的权利没有谈到不同社会群体的解释差异。 这一点很成问题,因为我们的结果表明,解释本身可能在许多方面在群体之间产生有害的差异。

blocks.en: Lastly, we state some limitations and future work. We used a single prompt template and single generations at T = 0 T=0 , a sentiment lexicon developed for product reviews, and a single extractor validated on 100 narratives. Narratives were generated in English, and social groups were compared as binary splits, without intersectional analysis. We did not study how applicants perceive these narratives: whether the observed differences affect how they understand, trust or contest decisions remains a question for future work, alongside extending the framework to other XAI artefacts, prompts, languages and intersectional groups.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们指出一些局限性和今后的工作。 我们使用一个单一的即时模板和单代在T=0 T=0,一个为产品审查开发的情感词典,以及一个在100个叙事上被验证的单一取词. 描述语用英语生成,社会群体被比作二进制分出,没有交叉分析. 我们没有研究申请人如何看待这些叙述:所观察到的差异是否影响到他们如何理解、信任或竞争决定,以及将框架扩大到其他XAI手工艺品、提示、语言和交叉群体,仍然是今后工作的一个问题。

blocks.en: Finally, we set aside the fairness of the predictive model and the SHAP artefact, which future work could combine with ours to audit the full explanation pipeline. Future work could also research the trade-off between privacy and faithfulness: passing applicant profiles to third-party LLMs poses privacy risks, while the smaller models that can be self-hosted (which avoid this risk) produced less faithful narratives in our study.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们搁置了预测模型和SHAP动脉动能的公平性,未来的工作可以和我们的工作结合起来,来审计充分的解释程序。 今后的工作还可以研究隐私与忠诚之间的取舍:将申请人简介传给第三方有限责任公司会造成隐私风险,而可以自行托管(避免这种风险)的较小模型则在我们的研究中产生不太忠实的叙述。

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 结论

blocks.en: This paper introduced fairness in XAINs as a distinct field of research and proposed a framework that traces disparities between social groups to their source by generating narratives with the protected attributes disclosed, withheld or counterfactually swapped. Applied to four high-risk datasets and five LLMs, it revealed disparities in faithfulness, feature coverage and sentiment, driven either by feature values that trigger plausible falsehoods or by the protected attribute itself. Neither withholding the protected attributes nor using a more expensive, faithful model removes both. As LLMs increasingly turn XAI artefacts into narratives people receive, the translation step must be audited for fairness in its own right.
blocks.zh: 本文将XAINs中的公平性作为一个独特的研究领域,并提出了一个框架,通过产生带有被披露、被扣留或被反相交换的受保护属性的叙述,将社会群体之间的差别追溯到其来源。 它应用到4个高风险数据集和5个LLMs中,揭示了在忠诚度、特征覆盖面和情绪方面的差异,这些差异或是由引发假象的特征值所驱动,或是由受保护的属性本身所驱动。 既不能隐瞒受保护的属性,也不能使用更昂贵的忠实模型去除两者. 随着LLMs日益将XAI工艺品变成人们所接受的叙事品,翻译步骤本身必须经过公平审计。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations Statement
blocks.zh: 道德考虑说明

blocks.en: This study involves no human subjects and collects no new data. All four datasets are publicly available datasets that contain no direct identifiers and that are widely used in fairness research. They were used in accordance with their licences. The main ethical concern is privacy. Generating a narrative requires passing at least part of an applicant’s profile to an LLM. In this study, this posed little risk, as all data were already public. In deployment, however, the same pipeline would send sensitive data of real applicants to third-party providers, raising questions of data protection (e.g. under the GDPR), data retention and purpose limitation. Self-hosting smaller models avoids this, but our results show that these models produce less faithful narratives, with more disparities between social groups. Institutions may therefore face a trade-off between privacy and explanation quality, which we flag as a risk. Second, comparing social groups requires categorising people, and our binary splits simplify this. Here, race is reduced to white versus non-white, and health and age are split at thresholds. These categories serve the statistical comparison only and are not meant to reflect how individuals identify. Last, our framework is intended to help detect unfair explanations across social groups, but it could also be misused to label narratives as fair based on a limited audit. A lack of significant disparities in our setting does not rule out smaller differences, other prompts or other social groups not included in this study, and should not be read as an endorsement of any model. To support this, we have publicly released all code, prompts, narratives and extractions.
blocks.zh: 这项研究不涉及人类课题,也没有收集新的数据。 所有四个数据集都是公开的数据集,没有直接的标识符,被广泛用于公平研究. 它们是根据许可证使用的。 主要的伦理问题是隐私。 编写叙述需要至少将申请人的部分情况传递给LLM。 在这项研究中,这种风险很小,因为所有数据都已公开。 不过,在部署过程中,同一管道将向第三方提供者发送真实申请人的敏感数据,从而引起数据保护(例如,根据GDPR),数据保留和目的限制等问题. 自宿小模型避免了这种情况,但我们的结果显示,这些模型产生的忠实叙事较少,社会群体之间的差别更大. 因此,各机构可能面临隐私与解释质量之间的取舍,我们将此视为一种风险。 第二,比较社会群体需要分类,我们的二分法简化了这一点。 这里,种族被缩小为白种与非白种,健康和年龄按阈值划分. 这些类别仅用于统计比较,并不反映个人如何识别。 最后,我们的框架旨在帮助发现所有社会群体的不公正解释,但也可能被滥用,在有限的审计基础上将叙述称为公平。 我们所处的环境没有重大差异,不排除本研究没有包括的较小差异、其他诱因或其他社会群体,不应被视为对任何模式的认可。 为了支持这一点,我们公开发布了所有代码,提示,叙事和摘录.

blocks.en: A.1. General procedures
blocks.zh: A.1. 一般程序

blocks.en: All tests are two-sided. For each comparison, only narratives for which the metric is non-missing are used (Table 6 ). A comparison was not evaluated when fewer than five non-missing observations were available per group (D1, D2, D5) or fewer than five complete pairs (D3, D4), or when the metric showed no variation that could constitute a difference (e.g., identical values in all narratives, or no discordant pairs). Raw p p -values were corrected using the Benjamini–Hochberg false-discovery-rate procedure ( α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 ), applied separately within batches (Table 4 ). Binary and continuous metrics always form separate batches, as they are structurally distinct test families and the continuous metrics are aggregates of the binary ones; unrelated protected attributes, social groups or counterfactual swaps likewise do not share a batch. Effect sizes are odds ratios for binary metrics and rank-biserial correlations for continuous metrics throughout, in the independent, matched or stratified form matching each design.
blocks.zh: 所有测试都是双面的. 对于每项比较,只使用衡量标准未遗漏的叙述(表6)。 当每组(D1,D2,D5)可获得的无遗漏观测数据少于5个或少于5个完整对(D3,D4),或者当衡量标准显示的变异不构成差异(例如,在所有叙述中值相同,或没有不相通对)时,没有加以评价。 Benjamini-Hochberg假发现率程序(α = 0.05\alpha = 0.05)对原始p-值进行了修正,在批次内分别适用(表4)。 二进制和连续度量衡总是形成单独的分批,因为它们是结构不同的测试家族,连续度量衡是二进制的集合;不相关的被保护属性,社会群体或反事实互换同样不共享分批. 效应大小是二进制度量的概率比和连续度量的等级-二进制相关性,在独立、匹配或分层形式上与每项设计相匹配。

The effect size is the odds ratio O ​ R = a ​ d / b ​ c OR=ad/bc , with 0.5 added to every cell when any cell is zero (Haldane–Anscombe correction). Continuous metrics were compared with the Mann–Whitney U U test, with effect size the rank-biserial correlation r = 2 ​ U / ( n 1 ​ n 2 ) − 1 r=2U/(n_{1}n_{2})-1 , where n 1 n_{1} and n 2 n_{2} are the group sizes.

blocks.en: A.4. Stratified comparisons (D5)
blocks.zh: A.4. 分级比较(D5)

blocks.en: D5 compares the counterfactual narratives of a counterfactual swap with the factual ( P ​ A disclosed PA_{\text{disclosed}} ) narratives of instances that actually hold the displayed protected-attribute value, from the same generator LLM. To hold all displayed protected attributes constant, narratives were matched on their displayed protected-attribute profile using coarsened exact matching: the swapped attribute is matched exactly, except for continuous age, which is split at the median; the other protected attributes are matched on the two-group splits of Figure 2 . Each profile forms a stratum, and strata containing only one side were dropped. As both sides consist of different applicants, stratified versions of the tests in Appendix A.2 were used, which reduce to those tests when there is a single stratum. The effect size is the Mantel–Haenszel common odds ratio, with 0.5 added to strata containing a zero cell. Continuous metrics were tested with the van Elteren test, a stratified Mann–Whitney U U test with stratum weights 1 / ( N h + 1 ) 1/(N_{h}+1) and tie correction, with effect size the rank-biserial correlation per stratum, averaged with weights n 1 ​ h ​ n 2 ​ h / N h n_{1h}n_{2h}/N_{h} , where n 1 ​ h n_{1h} and n 2 ​ h n_{2h} are the sizes of both sides in stratum h h and N h = n 1 ​ h + n 2 ​ h N_{h}=n_{1h}+n_{2h} .

blocks.en: Model comparisons are paired: for a given dataset and condition, every instance has one narrative per model, so each comparison between two models is made on the same instances. Binary indicators were tested with McNemar’s test as in Appendix A.3 , with effect size the paired odds ratio O ​ R = ( b + 0.5 ) / ( c + 0.5 ) OR=(b+0.5)/(c+0.5) , where b b and c c are the counts of discordant pairs favouring model 1 and model 2, respectively, so that values above 1 indicate that model 1 wins more of the discordant cases. Continuous metrics were tested with the Wilcoxon signed-rank test, with effect size the paired Cohen’s d z = d ¯ / s d d_{z}=\bar{d}/s_{d} , where d ¯ \bar{d} and s d s_{d} are the mean and standard deviation of the paired differences.
blocks.zh: 模型比较是成对的:对于一个给定的数据集和条件,每个实例每个模型都有一个叙事,所以两个模型之间的每次比较都是在同一实例上进行的. 如附录A.3所示,通过McNemar的测试测试了二进制指标,效果大小为对比比 O R = (b+0.5) / (c+0.5) OR=(b+0.5)/(c+0.5),其中b和c分别是偏好模式1和模式2的不相通对的计数,因此1以上值表明模式1赢得了更多不相通的个案. 连续的度量衡是通过Wilcoxon的签名排名测试测试的,其效果大小是配对的科恩的dz = d's / s d_{z}=\bar{d}/ s_{d},其中d'\bar{d}和s' s_{d}是配对差异的平均值和标准偏差.

blocks.en: Comparisons were made at three scopes: within a dataset (overall), within one social group of a dataset (group), and across all four datasets for the continuous metrics (pooled), pairing on the instance within its dataset. Under the P ​ A counterfactual PA_{\text{counterfactual}} condition, every instance has one narrative per counterfactual swap. To keep one observation per instance, the continuous metrics were averaged per instance and model over its counterfactual narratives for the overall and pooled scopes, and binary indicators were not tested at these scopes. In place of the group scope, each counterfactual swap was tested separately on all metrics, as all its narratives display the same swapped value.
blocks.zh: 在三个范围内进行了比较:在一个数据集(总体)、一个数据集(组)的一个社会组内,以及所有四个连续计量(集合)数据集,在其数据集内按实例对等。 在PA反事实 PAQQText{反事实}条件下,每个实例每个反事实互换有一个叙述. 为了保持每个实例的一丝不苟,连续的衡量尺度是每个实例的平均数和模型,而不是总体和集合范围的反事实说明,没有在这些范围测试二进制指标。 取而代之的是分组范围,每次反事实互换都在所有衡量标准上单独测试,因为其所有叙述都显示相同的互换值.
